name: Raisins
siboNotes: Small portions are well-tolerated, but the concentrated sugars in larger amounts may feed bacterial overgrowth and cause symptoms.
preparationTips: Measure portions carefully as it's easy to overconsume
Soak in warm water briefly to plump and reduce sweetness concentration
Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added sugars
Mix with low-FODMAP nuts for balanced snacking
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of potassium for heart health
Natural source of quick energy from natural sugars
